issues.description: The reference solution in aufgabe09.sql compares Gemeinde.name to the numeric literal 12345 (Gemeinde.name=12345). The problem statement asks for zoos in a municipality named "Erlangen" (a string). This creates a type/value mismatch and contradicts the task description, which will confuse students and cause the query to be incorrect.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution file aufgabe09.sql replace the numeric literal with the municipality name string used in the problem. For example: WHERE Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel AND Gemeinde.name = 'Erlangen'. Ensure the municipality name is quoted as a string literal.
